authority_basis: Current user instructions: previously studied material, targeted refresh, integrated recall/checking, all important tracks retained. These supersede earlier full-linear-revision and automatic separate-verification assumptions.
estimation_policy: These are fresh estimates of the revised preparation mode, not the previous feasibility cut package. No important track is deleted or assigned a zero unit budget.
Source length informs breadth and lookup needs, not linear reading time. Placement material and owned projects are treated as familiar; RecSys first-pass completion is not assumed.

Recall, explanation and checking are embedded in targeted refresh or active attempts where practical. Each component is charged once; seven legacy verification tasks become zero-additional-minute checkpoints inside named hosts.
DBMS closure is embedded in SQL error review and backend closure in MongoDB review. These checks do not trigger another blanket 30-minute subject session.
Project refresh still precedes a separate project questionnaire. Resume, HR and company components may share a focused session within their own tracks; no repeated project rehearsal is added.
EPQ uses one theory refresh and one numerical/cross-topic pass; RecSys units include their own recall. Final RecSys work is incremental synthesis/error checking, with no blanket repeat reading.
The conditional RecSys numericals budget is incremental work only and remains included in totals; no source redundancy claim or cut has been made.
CV is mandatory with a smaller explicitly uncertain working provision, not an evidence-based full-scope duration. Revisit only when reliable lecturer material arrives.
Previously selected external resources are reused. Resource-selection flags are resolved; remaining fluency, runtime and source gaps are stated explicitly.
Reasonableness anchors were checked after individual estimates. No capacity comparison, attendance arithmetic or schedule optimisation was used in this re-estimation.
inspection_note: One pass over saved estimates and task/resource bindings; reused previously inspected OA complexity and source-map scope. No raw notes, additional metadata counts, external browsing or resource research.
